task: Resource guard for agent platform UX/design screenshot smoke.

resource_risks.description: The static screenshot smoke starts a Python HTTP server that could remain running if not terminated.
resource_risks.mitigation: The server session was explicitly stopped with Ctrl-C after Playwright completed.
evidence: Server session output ended with Keyboard interrupt received, exiting.

resource_risks.description: Playwright Chromium pages and browser could remain open if the script does not close them.
resource_risks.mitigation: The script closes each page and calls browser.close() after the screenshot loop.
evidence: Playwright script contains await page.close() and await browser.close().

lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: Ctrl-C sent to the exec session after screenshot smoke.
evidence: HTTP server process exited with code 0 after Keyboard interrupt.

lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: await page.close() in each loop; await browser.close() after the loop.

measurement_checks.tool: exec session exit codes and Playwright command exit
measurement_checks.threshold: No long-running validation process remains after screenshot smoke.

notes: This task did not introduce a long-running runtime service.
Resource risk was limited to temporary validation processes.
